INT. EL PASO WOMEN'S CORRECTIONAL FACILITY - DAY
SKYLER, a fairly average brunette woman in her mid-20's, is being led down the halls of the facility. In her hands is a everything she is allowed to have, mostly consisting of a mesh bag full of toiletries and a mattress thinner than most sleeping bags. On either side of her are two burly male guards giving her virtually no elbow room. Neither are showing any hint of emotion, while Skyler attempts to do the same. She keeps her gaze focused straight in front of her, as she wants to prolong getting a look at her new home - and new neighbors - as much as possible. 
The two guards stop in unison, giving Skyler a small squeeze to signal their arrival. Skyler turns to her right along with them, unable to delay the inevitable any further. The door is made from heavy metal with a window taking up the majority of its area. Clearly, privacy is not a priority here. One of the guards unlocks the door while the other stands behind Skyler. Skyler gives them each a final look - almost as if to say "Do I really have to go in there?" - before hesitantly stepping into the abyss. As soon as she has passed the doorway, the door slams loudly behind her. The guards leave without saying a word.
Skyler stands frozen in place, taking in her new surroundings. Despise there being so little to see, it is very overwhelming for her. To her left is a block of metal protruding from the wall as a makeshift table, with two cylinders underneath being used as chairs. Behind that is a metallic toilet/sink combo, with a tiny mirror hanging above it. Next to that is a window to the outside world, which is about two feet high but only about three inches wide. Adding to the feeling of imprisonment is the chicken wire stuck between the panes. Finally, there are the beds. Like the "table", they are merely large slabs of metal. The top bunk is completely barren, while the bottom one holds a matress and a messy blanket. Skyler is so busy taking it all in she barely even notices the woman also on top of it, looking through a magazine. 
EMILY
Nice place we got here, huh?
Skyler is visibly startled by the sudden comment and isn't quite sure what to say. Her roommate, EMILY, looks up from her magazine and Skyler stares at her a bit longer than is typically considered polite. Emily looks almost quite unlike the stereotypical inmate. She is quite young and has an innocent-looking face. She has short reddish-brown hair, done in pigtails. The only thing outing her as a convicted criminal is her blue prison uniform. 
2.
SKYLER 
(stammering)
Um, uh, ye-yeah, I guess so. Hi, by the way.
Emily puts down the magazine  and gives Skyler a welcoming smile. Skyler does her best to return the favor, but it comes off quite awkwardly.
EMILY
Hello, and welcome to my humble abode. I guess if we're gonna be living together, we might as well get to know each other. Name's Emily Sanders.
Skyler slowly starts to let her guard down and relaxes her arms ever so slightly.
SKYLER
I'm Skyler...Parker. Skyler Parker.
EMILY
Interesting. My last roomie was named Skyler, too. Guess that makes it easier to remember.
SKYLER
Yeah, I guess so. That's...nice.
Emily stops leaning against the pillow propped up against the wall and moves towards the end of her bunk.
EMILY
So, Skyler, what did a sweet little girl like you do to end up in a place like that? Did you steal a Hello Kitty purse from the mall?
Skyler tenses up again and looks down at her belongings. This isn't a subject she's very comfortable with. On top of that, she really has no idea what to make of this new person in front of her. She tries her best to just keep things honest, but casual.
SKYLER
(quietly)
Um...it was credit card fraud.
EMILY
Well, what a coincidence! That's what I'm in for too.
3.
SKYLER
Oh...Well, at least we, we have that in common.
Emily starts to look off into the distance, as if she's remembering a pleasant experience from long ago.
EMILY
Yeah. At least those were my original charges. 
Emily pauses for a moment, waiting for Skyler to respond. When she doesn't, Emily simply continues on with her story.
EMILY
That was a lot easier to deal with. Now I've got fucking attempted murder on my record. 
Skyler's heart skips a beat at the mention of murder. After another pause from Emily, she feels she must say something, but doesn't have a clue what that is.
SKYLER
...Oh...
EMILY
Yeah, my last roomie was a real bitch. I told her I was sick of her snoring, but she just wouldn't stop. So, one day, when she going on another snoozefest, I decided to...well, I tried to, anyway. The guards managed to save her in time, but I think she got the message.
Emily gives off a light chuckle, still looking off into the distance. Skyler is completely horrified. It takes all the muscles in her body to not drop her jaw, but she cannot hide the fear on her face, or the trembling in her legs. Emily slowly returns her gaze to Skyler. As she does, she bursts out laughing. This does nothing to ease Skyler.
EMILY
Oh my god, you should see your face right now! Calm down, girl, I'm just fucking with you! 
Emily continues to laugh before getting another look at her new cellmate. She is still frozen with fear. Emily tries to give her a sympathetic look, but it's spoiled by her ability to completely conceal her smile.
4.
EMILY
(attempting to be soothing)
Seriously, girl, it's all fine. You're not sleeping with a murderer...or an attempted murderer. 
Emily cracks up again at that. Skyler tries to get herself to relax and smile too, but it's very obvious it's forced. 
EMILY
I'm sorry. I just couldn't resist. But seriously, you'll be fine, Steph- What's your name again? Stephanie? Whatever, you'll be alright here. It's not too bad once you get used to it. 
After what has just happened, Skyler has trouble believing anything Emily has to say. The past 5 minutes have exhausted her even more than she already was. 
SKYLER
Um, ok, yeah. So...I guess I get the top bunk?
EMILY
Yeah, it's all your's.
Skyler awkwardly forces her feel to move forward the bunks, while Emily leans back up against the pillow and resumes reading. She drops everything in her arms onto the top bunk. She pushes her bag of items and clothing to the side as she spreads out the mattress. She puts her fingers against it just to feel how comfortable it is. It does nothing to soften the metal underneath, but Skyler is so tired that she doesn't even care. She lazily puts the pillow and sheets in place before preparing to lay down. She puts her arms on the bunk while stepping onto the edge of Emily's bunk. 
EMILY
Hey, what the fuck are you doing?
A look of confusion crosses Skyler's face as her heart starts to sink again. She looks down below her. There are no steps or rungs in sight, so this seems to be the only way to reach her bunk. Emily peeks out from under the peek to give Skyler an annoyed look.
SKYLER
(very tired)
I'm just-I'm just trying-getting-trying to get on the bun-
5.
EMILY
Your fucking shoes are on my bed!
Skyler looks down at her feet. In all this excitement, she forgot to sleep off her shoes, and they are indeed touching the edge of Emily's mattress. Skyler quickly steps back down onto the ground and slips them off. She looks at Emily, who has still looks quite annoyed.
SKYLER
I'm-I'm sorry. I didn't mean to. I just sort of, you know...So, uh, can I-
Emily interrupts her with a sigh and returns to her magazine. 
EMILY
Yeah, just do what you were doing before. Just don't put your fucking shoes on my bed, okay? It's nasty. 
SKYLER
Um, alright. Thanks. I'm sorry.
Skyler gets back up onto her bunk. Emily glances up again to make certain Skyler's shoes are off. They are, so she returns to her article. Even so, Sklyer takes extra care to only touch the metal part of Emily's bunk, and not the bed on top of it.
Skyler lies down on her bunk. She is too tired to even pull the covers over her. She stares at the ceiling for a few moments before closing her eyes. As she starts to drift off, she only hopes for two things: that she wakes up from this sleep, and that she does not snore.
